newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile praises Deng as outstanding politician.
newsitem.headline: Chile praises Deng as outstanding politician.

text.p: Chilean President Eduardo Frei sent condolences to China on Thursday on the death of leader Deng Xiaoping, describing him as an outstanding politician.

"I would like to express in the name of the government of Chile and in my own, my most sincere sympathy...on the regrettable death of political leader Deng Xiaoping who was an exceptional public man," Frei said in a message to President Jiang Zemin.
"The death of the person who was a great force behind the reforms in your country and architect of China's opening to the international community, leaves a space in the world scene," Frei said.
